text:
Predicates:
RegisterToVoteUS(x) ::: x can register to vote in the United States.
Participate2024Election(x) ::: x can participate in the 2024 United States presidential election.
USCitizen(x) ::: x has United States citizenship.
TaiwaneseCitizen(x) ::: x has Taiwanese citizenship.
RussianOfficial(x) ::: x is a Russian Federation official.
ManagerGazprom(x) ::: x is a manager at Gazprom.
Premises:
∀x (RegisterToVoteUS(x) → Participate2024Election(x)) ::: Everyone who can register to vote in the United States can participate in the 2024 United States presidential election.
∀x (USCitizen(x) → RegisterToVoteUS(x)) ::: If someone has United States citizenship, then they can register to vote in the United States.
∀x (USCitizen(x) ⊕ TaiwaneseCitizen(x)) ::: A person either has United States citizenship or Taiwanese citizenship.
∀x (RussianOfficial(x) → ¬TaiwaneseCitizen(x)) ::: No Russian Federation officials hold Taiwanese citizenship.
¬TaiwaneseCitizen(vladimir) ∧ ¬ManagerGazprom(vladimir) ::: Vladimir neither holds Taiwanese citizenship nor is he a manager at Gazprom.
RegisterToVoteUS(ekaterina) ⊕ RussianOfficial(ekaterina) ::: Ekaterina can register to vote in the United States, or she is a Russian Federation official.
Conclusion:
Participate2024Election(ekaterina) ∨ ManagerGazprom(vladimir) ::: Ekaterina can participate in the 2024 United States presidential election or Vladimir is a manager at Gazprom.
